question.text: How many total 2026 measles-associated deaths will CDC's measles data page report as of November 26, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves based on the number of measles-associated deaths reported for 2026 in the "U.S. Deaths" table of the CDC's "Measles Cases and Outbreaks" page — specifically the value in the "Total Deaths" row under the "2026" column — as that page appeared at 23:59 UTC on November 26, 2026 (https://www.cdc.gov/measles/data-research/index.html). The number displayed on the page at that time is the resolved value (for example, a displayed total of 8 resolves as 8). If the page layout has changed, the total number of 2026 measles-associated deaths stated anywhere on that page at that time applies. Figures published or revised after 23:59 UTC on November 26, 2026 do not count.
question.fine_print: If the live page no longer shows the version that was in effect at 23:59 UTC on November 26, 2026, that version will be identified from its "Updated on" date or, failing that, from the Internet Archive capture of the page closest to that time. If the page or the figure is unavailable, CDC's reported total as described by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used.

research:
I could not open the CDC page's underlying data file (raw fetch returned 403) or Internet Archive captures (rate-limited, 429). The page's figures were read through a summarising fetch.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-13: The CDC page says "Updated November 13, 2026", with data as of 12:00 PM Thursday, Nov 12. It shows 5,412 confirmed cases and **6 measles deaths**, with an asterisk saying the number is subject to change. It also says CDC is working with the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists (CSTE) on a standard case definition for measles deaths. My fetch did not show the 2026 and 2025 columns separately. [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/measles/data-research/index.html)
- Path of the 2026 figure (from the question background): 1 (Sept 24), 3 (data as of Oct 29), 4 (Nov 5), 6 (Nov 12). The page has been updated on Fridays (Oct 30, Nov 6, Nov 13). The next expected update is Fri Nov 20, with data as of Nov 19. The one after would be Fri Nov 27, after the resolution cutoff. That is my inference from the pattern: I could not find a published Thanksgiving schedule.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The page shows 6 now. State-reported deaths total 10: Pennsylvania 7, Wisconsin 2, New York 1. That leaves 4 deaths CDC has not counted.
- 2026-11-12: Per Reuters, the federal count now uses verified National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) mortality data under Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) procedures, not state health department figures. CDC did not say which states its 6 deaths are in. [KFGO/Reuters](https://kfgo.com/2026/11/12/us-cdc-confirms-six-measles-related-deaths-in-2026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-14/15: Several outlets report 10 US measles deaths, "exceeding the provisional federal count of 6." [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/measles-associated-deaths-reach-10-in-us-after-two-more-deaths-reported), [ABC](https://abcnews.com/Health/measles-cases-nationwide-top-5400-outbreaks-spread-us/story?id=138108176), [DW](https://www.dw.com/es/eeuu-registra-diez-muertes-por-sarampi%C3%B3n-y-m%C3%A1s-de-5400-casos-en-lo-que-va-de-2026/a-79950308)
- 2026-11-15: KFF Health News reports that the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) commission concluded measles is endemic in the US, with a public announcement planned for Nov 17. [Latin Times](https://www.latintimes.com/paho-revokes-us-measles-elimination-status-601372)
- 2026-11-13: Pennsylvania reported its 7th death, an unvaccinated Montour County resident (1,542 state cases). Wisconsin reported its 2nd death, a child or infant. [The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/6220695-measles-cases-increase-pennsylvania-wisconsin/), [AOL](https://www.aol.com/articles/pennsylvania-reports-seventh-measles-linked-192132000.html)
- 2026-11-12: Reuters says the CDC site lists 6 deaths, double 2025. [US News/Reuters](https://www.usnews.com/news/top-news/articles/2026-11-12/us-cdc-confirms-six-measles-related-deaths-in-2026)
- 2026-11-05: Wisconsin announced its first death, an infant; the coroner listed measles as the cause. [WI DHS](https://www.dhs.wisconsin.gov/node/154446), [Wisconsin Examiner](https://wisconsinexaminer.com/?p=48799)
- 2026-11-02: New York reported a child's death. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/measles-associated-deaths-reach-10-in-us-after-two-more-deaths-reported)
- Nov 6-9: CDC listed 4 deaths against 8 reported by states. [Contagion Live](https://www.contagionlive.com/view/measles-update-november-6-2026)
- Late Aug to Sept: Reuters reported that HHS Secretary Kennedy asked CDC Director Schwartz to remove two Pennsylvania (Lancaster County) deaths, and she did. Pennsylvania counts a death as "measles-associated" if it occurs within 30 days of symptom onset, unless an unrelated event caused it. The Lancaster coroner says it has no record of measles deaths. [The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/6063769-cdc-disputes-pennsylvania-measles-deaths/), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/01/health/cdc-measles-deaths), [FactCheck.org](https://www.factcheck.org/2026/08/what-we-know-about-pennsylvanias-two-measles-associated-deaths/), [NOTUS](https://www.notus.org/healthcare/rfk-cdc-scrubs-two-pennsylvania-measles-deaths-from-website)

## 4. Base rates
- CDC's count has risen in steps: +2 (Oct 29 data), +1 (Nov 5), +2 (Nov 12). Before that it stayed at 1-2 for weeks while Pennsylvania reported 4-6 deaths. That is about +5 over the last 3 weekly updates, with some weeks flat earlier.
- The CDC count has trailed state counts by 2 to 4 deaths throughout. On Nov 5 it was 4 against 8; on Nov 12 it was 6 against 8 (10 by Nov 13).
- Deaths announced by states on Nov 13 would normally miss the Nov 12 data cutoff. The Nov 19 cutoff is the first one that could include them, but past lags have been weeks long, and some Pennsylvania deaths have been disputed or held back.
- Seasonality: there is no meaningful multi-year record for this 2026 page. The 2025 total was 3 deaths, and recent earlier years had 0 to 2. Measles is not strongly seasonal in late November.
- Downward revisions have happened before: two deaths were removed in late August.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold, "Number of measles deaths reported by CDC in the US in 2026": 0-10 at 90%, 11-25 at 6%. It resolves on the full-year figure no earlier than March 2027, so it is only loosely related. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/JZB/number-of-measles-deaths-reported-b)
- Kalshi and Polymarket: I found no market on deaths, only on cases. Kalshi puts 2026 cases above 7,000 at 0.78, and Polymarket puts 6,000+ cases by Nov 30 at 0.545.
- I found no expert forecasts of the CDC death count.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-17: PAHO's public announcement on US elimination status, which may raise pressure on how deaths are reported.
- About 2026-11-20 (Fri): the likely last CDC update before the cutoff, with data as of Nov 19. It could add Wisconsin #2, Pennsylvania #7 or others not yet counted, depending on the NCHS and HHS review.
- 2026-11-26 (Thanksgiving): an update on Wed Nov 25 or Thu Nov 26 is possible but unconfirmed. If the Friday pattern holds, the Nov 27 update falls after the cutoff.
- Wildcards: new deaths reported by states (Pennsylvania's outbreak is ongoing, with 305 hospitalizations), the CDC/CSTE definition of a measles death being finalised, or further HHS intervention or reclassification.
- Weather is not relevant.

## Research summary: CDC's reported 2026 measles deaths as of Nov 26, 2026

**Bottom line:** CDC's page currently shows 6 deaths for 2026. State health departments have reported 10. The 4-death gap comes from a federal review and classification dispute that is still running. CDC's count has gone 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 6 between Sept 23 and Nov 12.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-16: I could not read the CDC page directly (it returned HTTP 403), and the Internet Archive timed out. So I could not confirm the live figure or its "Updated on" date myself. [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/measles/data-research/index.html)
- 2026-11-13: Contagion Live reports the CDC page, dated Nov 13 with data as of Nov 12, showing **6 deaths in 2026** against 3 for 2025, with the note that the figure "may change as additional reviews are completed." [Contagion Live](https://www.contagionlive.com/view/measles-update-november-13-2026)
- 2026-11-12: Reuters (via US News and Star-Advertiser) also says CDC confirmed 6 deaths. CDC did not say which states they were in. [US News](https://www.usnews.com/news/top-news/articles/2026-11-12/us-cdc-confirms-six-measles-related-deaths-in-2026), [Star-Advertiser](https://www.staradvertiser.com/2026/11/12/breaking-news/cdc-confirms-6-measles-related-deaths-in-2026/)

### 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The latest known CDC value is 6. State-reported deaths total **10**: Pennsylvania 7, Wisconsin 2, New York 1. [ABC News](https://abcnews.com/Health/measles-cases-nationwide-top-5400-outbreaks-spread-us/story?id=138108176)
- At least two state-reported deaths, Pennsylvania's 7th and Wisconsin's 2nd (both announced Nov 13), came after CDC's Nov 12 data cutoff and could appear in the next refresh. I found nothing confirming which of the other 8 state-reported deaths CDC already counts.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-15/17: KFF Health News reports that PAHO's commission has concluded measles is endemic in the US, with an announcement scheduled for Nov 17. This affects elimination status, not death counts directly. [Latin Times](https://www.latintimes.com/paho-revokes-us-measles-elimination-status-601372)
- 2026-11-14: Al Jazeera puts the state-reported total at 10 for 2026 (13 since last year). It says Kennedy asked CDC Director Erica Schwartz not to count some deaths. CDC is working with the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists (CSTE) on a standard definition of a measles death. Pennsylvania counts a death if a confirmed case dies within 30 days of symptom onset. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/measles-associated-deaths-reach-10-in-us-after-two-more-deaths-reported)
- 2026-11-13: Pennsylvania reports its 7th death (an unvaccinated Montour County resident) and Wisconsin its 2nd pediatric death. [AOL](https://www.aol.com/articles/pennsylvania-reports-seventh-measles-linked-192132000.html)
- 2026-11-02 to 11-05: New York, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin each announce a death. [Contagion Live](https://www.contagionlive.com/view/measles-update-november-13-2026)
- Search summaries say CDC switched from state health department reports to National Center for Health Statistics mortality data for counting deaths. I could not confirm this in a primary source.
- 2026-09 (around Sept 4-20): Reuters, citing three unnamed sources, reported that Kennedy asked for Pennsylvania deaths to be removed from the CDC tally and that Schwartz complied. CDC asked for records containing personally identifiable information, which Pennsylvania says it is legally barred from sharing. [Daily Mirror/Reuters](https://www.dailymirror.lk/breaking-news/Kennedy-asked-to-remove-Pennsylvania-measles-death-from-CDC-tally--sources-say/108-349366), [Mediaite](https://mediaite.com/media/news/cdc-chief-excludes-pa-measles-deaths-against-states-own-health-dept-assessment-after-rfk-casts-doubt)

### 4. Base rates and trend
How CDC's 2026 count has moved:
- 2026-09-23: 1. [Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/2026/09/23/cdc-updates-measles-death-toll-one-despite-pennsylvanias-higher-tally/)
- 2026-09-30: 2, while Pennsylvania had reported 4. [6abc](https://6abc.com/post/cdc-updates-measles-death-toll-2-2026/19891630/)
- around 2026-10-20: 3. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/20/cdc-reports-third-measles-death-in-the-united-states-this-year)
- 2026-11-05: 4
- 2026-11-12: 6

Pattern:
- That is +5 in about 7 weekly refreshes. The count rose at 4 of the roughly 7 refreshes, by +1 or +2 each time, and has never gone down.
- CDC has lagged the state tally by about 2 to 4 deaths throughout.
- In a 2-week window like the one to resolution, past changes have been 0 to +2.

Seasonality and past years:
- Death counts are not really seasonal. Changes here are driven by when reviews finish.
- In earlier years (2019 to 2024: 0 to 2 deaths a year; 2025: 3 deaths) the CDC total barely moved between mid- and late November.
- This year is far above any recent year.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold, "Number of measles deaths reported by CDC in the US in 2026": 0-10 deaths at 90%, 11-25 at 6%. This is a year-end market that will not resolve before March 1, 2027, so it only loosely relates to the Nov 26 snapshot. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/JZB/number-of-measles-deaths-reported-b)
- Kalshi and Polymarket have markets on case counts (for example, Kalshi gives "above 7,000 cases in 2026" 0.78) and elimination status (0.98 Yes). I found no market on CDC death counts.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **Around Nov 19-20:** the next weekly CDC refresh (data as of Thursday Nov 19). This is likely the last update before resolution if the Thanksgiving-week refresh is moved earlier or skipped. I could not confirm CDC's holiday schedule. Thanksgiving is Nov 26, so a refresh around Nov 25 is possible but uncertain.
- **Nov 17:** expected PAHO announcement on US elimination status. This could increase pressure on CDC's reporting.
- **Pending:** CDC/CSTE work on a standard measles death definition, plus ongoing CDC reviews of Pennsylvania and Wisconsin deaths. Either could raise the count, or reclassification could lower it.
- New state-announced deaths are also possible. Pennsylvania announced its 6th and 7th within about 10 days.
- The weather is not relevant to this question.

- Low: HHS or NCHS review reclassifies one or two deaths, as with the Lancaster removals, or the CDC/CSTE case definition tightens. The count could fall to 4 or 5.
- High: CDC adopts the CSTE definition and clears the whole state backlog. Two refreshes land before Thanksgiving, and Pennsylvania reports new deaths. The count could reach 10 to 12.
